verses.original: δὲ προσλαμβάνεσθε Τὸν τῇ πίστει ἀσθενοῦντα μὴ εἰς διακρίσεις διαλογισμῶν
verses.transliteration: de proslambanesthe Ton tē pistei asthenounta mē eis diakriseis dialogismōn
verses.literal: - Accept him whose - faith is weak without . . . passing judgment on [his] opinions

verses.original: μὲν ὃς πιστεύει φαγεῖν πάντα δὲ ὁ ἀσθενῶν ἐσθίει λάχανα
verses.transliteration: men hos pisteuei phagein panta de ho asthenōn esthiei lachana
verses.literal: For one [person] has faith to eat all things while another who is weak eats [only] vegetables

verses.original: ὁ ἐσθίων μὴ ἐξουθενείτω τὸν μὴ ἐσθίοντα δὲ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων μὴ κρινέτω τὸν ἐσθίοντα γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς προσελάβετο αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: ho esthiōn mē exoutheneitō ton mē esthionta de ho mē esthiōn mē krinetō ton esthionta gar ho Theos proselabeto auton
verses.literal: The [one who] eats [everything] vvv must not belittle the [one who] vvv [does not] and the [one who] vvv does not eat [everything] vvv must not judge the [one who] [does] for - God has accepted him

verses.original: τίς εἶ σὺ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ στήκει ἢ πίπτει δέ σταθήσεται γὰρ ὁ Κύριος δυνατεῖ αὐτόν στῆσαι
verses.transliteration: tis ei sy ho krinōn allotrion oiketēn tō idiō kyriō stēkei ē piptei de stathēsetai gar ho Kyrios dynatei auton stēsai
verses.literal: Who are you - to judge someone else’s servant To [his] own master he stands or falls And he will stand for the Lord is able vvv to make him stand

verses.original: γὰρ μὲν Ὃς κρίνει ἡμέραν παρ’ ἡμέραν δὲ ὃς κρίνει πᾶσαν ἡμέραν ἕκαστος πληροφορείσθω ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ νοῒ
verses.transliteration: gar men Hos krinei hēmeran par’ hēmeran de hos krinei pasan hēmeran hekastos plērophoreisthō en tō idiō noi
verses.literal: - - One [person] regards [a certain] day above [the others] while someone [else] considers every day [alike] Each [one] should be fully convinced in [his] own mind

verses.original: ὁ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν φρονεῖ Κυρίῳ ὁ ἐσθίων ἐσθίει Κυρίῳ γὰρ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων οὐκ ἐσθίει Κυρίῳ καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ho phronōn tēn hēmeran phronei Kyriō ho esthiōn esthiei Kyriō gar eucharistei tō Theō kai ho mē esthiōn ouk esthiei Kyriō kai eucharistei tō Theō
verses.literal: He who observes - [a special] day [does so] to [the] Lord he who eats [does so] to [the] Lord for he gives thanks - to God and he who vvv abstains vvv [does so] to [the] Lord and gives thanks - to God

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐδεὶς ἡμῶν ζῇ ἑαυτῷ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀποθνῄσκει ἑαυτῷ
verses.transliteration: gar Oudeis hēmōn zē heautō kai oudeis apothnēskei heautō
verses.literal: For none of us lives to himself [alone] and none [ of us ] dies to himself [alone]

verses.original: γὰρ τε ἐάν ζῶμεν ζῶμεν τῷ Κυρίῳ τε ἐάν ἀποθνήσκωμεν ἀποθνήσκομεν τῷ Κυρίῳ οὖν τε ἐάν ζῶμεν τε ἐάν ἀποθνήσκωμεν ἐσμέν τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: gar te ean zōmen zōmen tō Kyriō te ean apothnēskōmen apothnēskomen tō Kyriō oun te ean zōmen te ean apothnēskōmen esmen tou Kyriou
verses.literal: - - If we live we live to the Lord and if we die we die to the Lord So - whether we live [or] - die we belong to the Lord

verses.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν ἵνα κυριεύσῃ καὶ νεκρῶν καὶ ζώντων
verses.transliteration: eis touto gar Christos apethanen kai ezēsen hina kyrieusē kai nekrōn kai zōntōn
verses.literal: For this reason . . . Christ died and returned to life that He might be the Lord of both [the] dead and [the] living

verses.original: τί δὲ Σὺ κρίνεις σου τὸν ἀδελφόν ἢ τί καὶ σὺ ἐξουθενεῖς σου τὸν ἀδελφόν γὰρ πάντες παραστησόμεθα τοῦ Θεοῦ τῷ βήματι
verses.transliteration: ti de Sy krineis sou ton adelphon ē ti kai sy exoutheneis sou ton adelphon gar pantes parastēsometha tou Theou tō bēmati
verses.literal: Why then {do} you judge your - brother Or why - {do} you belittle your - brother For vvv we will all stand before vvv God’s - judgment seat

verses.original: γάρ γέγραπται ἐγώ Ζῶ λέγει Κύριος ὅτι πᾶν γόνυ κάμψει ἐμοὶ καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar gegraptai egō Zō legei Kyrios hoti pan gony kampsei emoi kai pasa glōssa exomologēsetai tō Theō
verses.literal: - It is written [As surely as] I live says [the] Lord - every knee will bow before Me - every tongue will confess - to God

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ἕκαστος ἡμῶν δώσει λόγον περὶ ἑαυτοῦ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Ara oun hekastos hēmōn dōsei logon peri heautou tō Theō
verses.literal: So then each of us will give an account of himself - to God

verses.original: οὖν Μηκέτι κρίνωμεν ἀλλήλους ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον κρίνατε τοῦτο μὴ τὸ τιθέναι πρόσκομμα ἢ σκάνδαλον τῷ ἀδελφῷ
verses.transliteration: oun Mēketi krinōmen allēlous alla mallon krinate touto mē to tithenai proskomma ē skandalon tō adelphō
verses.literal: Therefore vvv let us stop judging one another Instead . . . make up your mind - not - to put [any] stumbling block or obstacle vvv in your brother’s way

verses.original: Οἶδα καὶ πέπεισμαι ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι οὐδὲν κοινὸν δι’ ἑαυτοῦ εἰ μὴ τῷ λογιζομένῳ τι εἶναι κοινὸν ἐκείνῳ κοινόν
verses.transliteration: Oida kai pepeismai en Kyriō Iēsou hoti ouden koinon di’ heautou ei mē tō logizomenō ti einai koinon ekeinō koinon
verses.literal: I am convinced and fully persuaded in [the] Lord Jesus that nothing [is] unclean in itself But if . . . [anyone] regards something as unclean [then] for him [it is] unclean

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ σου ὁ ἀδελφός λυπεῖται διὰ βρῶμα οὐκέτι περιπατεῖς κατὰ ἀγάπην μὴ τῷ βρώματί ἀπόλλυε σου ἐκεῖνον ὑπὲρ οὗ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: gar ei sou ho adelphos lypeitai dia brōma ouketi peripateis kata agapēn mē tō brōmati apollye sou ekeinon hyper hou Christos apethanen
verses.literal: - If your - brother is distressed by [what you eat] vvv you are no longer acting in love {Do} not by [your eating] destroy your [brother] for whom Christ died

verses.original: Μὴ τὸ ὑμῶν ἀγαθόν οὖν βλασφημείσθω
verses.transliteration: Mē to hymōn agathon oun blasphēmeisthō
verses.literal: {Do} not {allow} what you [consider] good then to be spoken of as evil

verses.original: γάρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν οὐ βρῶσις καὶ πόσις ἀλλὰ δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ χαρὰ ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: gar hē basileia tou Theou estin ou brōsis kai posis alla dikaiosynē kai eirēnē kai chara en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: For the kingdom - of God is not [a matter of] eating and drinking but of righteousness - peace and joy in [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ δουλεύων τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τούτῳ εὐάρεστος τῷ Θεῷ καὶ δόκιμος τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: gar ho douleuōn tō Christō en toutō euarestos tō Theō kai dokimos tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: For whoever serves - Christ in this way [is] pleasing - to God and approved - by men

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν διώκωμεν τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης καὶ τὰ τῆς εἰς ἀλλήλους τῆς οἰκοδομῆς
verses.transliteration: Ara oun diōkōmen ta tēs eirēnēs kai ta tēs eis allēlous tēs oikodomēs
verses.literal: So then let us pursue what leads to - peace and to - vvv mutual - edification

verses.original: μὴ κατάλυε τὸ ἔργον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἕνεκεν βρώματος μὲν πάντα καθαρά ἀλλὰ κακὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ διὰ ἐσθίοντι προσκόμματος
verses.transliteration: mē katalye to ergon tou Theou heneken brōmatos men panta kathara alla kakon tō anthrōpō tō dia esthionti proskommatos
verses.literal: {Do} not destroy the work - of God for the sake of food - All [food is] clean but [it is] wrong - for a man - vvv to let his eating be a stumbling block

verses.original: καλὸν μὴ τὸ φαγεῖν κρέα μηδὲ πιεῖν οἶνον μηδὲ ἐν ᾧ σου ὁ ἀδελφός προσκόπτει
verses.transliteration: kalon mē to phagein krea mēde piein oinon mēde en hō sou ho adelphos proskoptei
verses.literal: [It is] better not - to eat meat [or] drink wine [or to do anything] vvv [to cause] your - brother to stumble

verses.original: ἔχε Σὺ πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις κατὰ σεαυτὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μακάριος ὁ μὴ κρίνων ἑαυτὸν ἐν ᾧ δοκιμάζει
verses.transliteration: eche Sy pistin hēn echeis kata seauton enōpion tou Theou makarios ho mē krinōn heauton en hō dokimazei
verses.literal: Keep your belief [about such matters] . . . between yourself [and] - God Blessed [is] the [one who] vvv does not condemn himself by what he approves

verses.original: δὲ ὁ διακρινόμενος κατακέκριται ἐὰν φάγῃ ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως δὲ πᾶν ὃ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἐστίν ἁμαρτία
verses.transliteration: de ho diakrinomenos katakekritai ean phagē hoti ouk ek pisteōs de pan ho ouk ek pisteōs estin hamartia
verses.literal: But the [one who] has doubts is condemned if he eats because [his eating is] not from faith and everything that [is] not from faith is sin
